(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)) (bg 7)
         (lw (cell-at g 0 0)) (rw (cell-at g 0 (- w 1)))
         ;; Mutable lookup table for result
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) bg))
    (for ((r (range 0 h)))
      (hash-set! result (list r 0) lw)
      (hash-set! result (list r (- w 1)) rw))
    (for ((wc-dir (list (list lw -1) (list rw 1))))
      (let ((wc (first wc-dir)) (dir (second wc-dir))
            ;; Mutable lookup table for visited
            (visited (make-hash))
            (all-objects (list)))
        (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 1 (- w 1))))
          (when (and (= (cell-at g r c) wc) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
            (let ((cells (list))
                  (queue (list (list r c))))
              (let bfs ((q queue))
                (when (not (null? q))
                  (let ((cr (first (car q))) (cc (second (car q))))
                    (cond
                      ((or (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                           (< cr 0) (>= cr h) (< cc 1) (>= cc (- w 1))
                           (not (= (cell-at g cr cc) wc)))
                       (bfs (cdr q)))
                      (else
                       (hash-set! visited (list cr cc) #t)
                       (set! cells (cons (list cr cc) cells))
                       (bfs (append (cdr q)
                         (list (list (- cr 1) (- cc 1)) (list (- cr 1) cc) (list (- cr 1) (+ cc 1))
                               (list cr (- cc 1)) (list cr (+ cc 1))
                               (list (+ cr 1) (- cc 1)) (list (+ cr 1) cc) (list (+ cr 1) (+ cc 1))))))))))
              (set! all-objects (append all-objects (list cells))))))
        (set! all-objects
          (sort all-objects
            (lambda (a b)
              (if (= dir 1)
                  (> (apply max (map second a)) (apply max (map second b)))
                  (< (apply min (map second a)) (apply min (map second b)))))))
        (for ((obj all-objects))
          (let ((min-shift 999))
            (for ((cell obj))
              (let* ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell))
                     (shift 0))
                (if (= dir 1)
                    (let scan ((t c))
                      (if (and (< (+ t 1) w) (= (hash-ref result (list r (+ t 1)) 0) bg))
                          (scan (+ t 1))
                          (set! shift (- t c))))
                    (let scan ((t c))
                      (if (and (> (- t 1) -1) (= (hash-ref result (list r (- t 1)) 0) bg))
                          (scan (- t 1))
                          (set! shift (- c t)))))
                (when (< shift min-shift)
                  (set! min-shift shift))))
            (for ((cell obj))
              (hash-set! result (list (first cell) (+ (second cell) (* dir min-shift))) wc))))))
    (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
